items.prompt: ___ had she closed the door than the phone rang.
items.explanation: 'No sooner... than' forces inversion: No sooner + aux + subject.

items.prompt: So tired ___ that she fell asleep on the train.
items.explanation: 'So + adjective' at the front inverts the subject and verb.

items.prompt: Choose the formal sentence with inversion:
options: Rarely have I seen such talent.
Rarely I have seen such talent.
I rarely have seen such talent.
Have rarely I seen such talent.
items.explanation: Negative adverbials like 'rarely' at the front trigger inversion.

items.prompt: Complete: Not only ___ she late, she also forgot the documents.
Rewrite starting with 'Never': "I have never seen such a mess."
answers: Never have I seen such a mess
items.explanation: 'Never' at the front inverts to 'have I'.

items.prompt: Rewrite starting with 'So': "The film was so boring that I left early."
answers: So boring was the film that I left early
items.explanation: 'So + adjective' at the front inverts the subject and verb.
